GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Not Bustled Settled Down Run Of Race 3rd Inside 3 Lengths asked to go at the 400m clear run home Middle Of Track only into 2nd x shadows, had its chance ! - # had all favours

Jumped well then Restrained and Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, enjoyed run of the race, trailed 1.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn until the 300m, got clear and came on to take Lead at the 60m # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had some difficulty securing clear running during the early stages of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths race run to suit held together same to straightening up challenged Leader x 200m, Took over x 100m (b/off) # had all favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Awkwardly placed at heels near the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward Took sit 2nd Outside 1/2 Lengths faced breeze but 1st was 3 Wide 3rd Out On A Limb challenged Leader Soon After Straightening Up , in Lead @ 300m Collared x 150m, Kept Trying - # Sound Effort
Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside sat 5th Outside 4 Lengths and Outside winner to Straightening Up immed Under Pressure , couldn't quicken enough on line - # had its chance
Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 2 Lengths Clear ran along same to straightening up only Collared x 50m, - # gave good sight
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, still 1.5L clear 200m, 1 length clear 100m, headed 50m, swamped late # led/headed 50m
Jumped Ok sat handy 2 Lengths off, held together turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, found little, plodded home # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated the gelding travelled satisfactorily until shortly after entering the straight when he felt it was disappointing in its failure to respond to his riding. Tnr rep subsequently reported the gelding pulled up well and trotted up sound.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 5 Lengths Not Bustled hence Settled Down Clear last 9 Lengths railed within 4 Lengths x 400m now following 1st x 2 Lengths then Under Pressure x 300m couldn't finish off was # Slow Out 5
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Became fractious in the barriers prior to the start being effected and as a result lost significant ground (5L). Tnr advised the gelding will now be spelled and would barrier trial before it races again. Tnr was advised a warning would be placed on the gelding in respect of its barrier manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drove through to lead half clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, same approaching 100m and kept on strong to the line # led/kept finding
